text:
Maria Chen: Quick note — I ran the multi-region write simulation targeting eu-west + us-central with our new locality tags and saw a weird degraded mode.
Devon Patel: what weird?
Maria Chen: tail latency spikes on writes when the eu region is failing and proxy routes to us. 95th -> 3s, p99 -> 6s for a minute.
Jordan Lee: did the proxy keep the original X-Region-Intent header?
Maria Chen: yes, proxy forwarded X-Region-Intent: eu and X-Write-TTL:30s. The write went to us but we saw an extra reconciliation step that blocked commit.
Anya Rivera: sounds like the 'remote-accept-but-defer-ack' path we added. Did you hit the old KV ownership check that blocks ack until escrow confirms?
Maria Chen: exactly. When ownership check times out we fall back to escrow reconciliation which is sync-heavy.
Devon Patel: proposal: add 'local-quick-ack' mode — proxy can request a provisional client ack with intent tag preserved; background reconciliation writes are async. We already do this for reads.
Jordan Lee: risk: client might see success for a write that later is rolled back if legal residency requires it.
Alex Morgan: can mitigate: provisional ack only for tenants without strict residency flags. Add a tenant-level policy bit 'locale_strict' to block quick ack.
Anya Rivera: also need an observability signal: provisional_ack=true on traces + post-commit verification TTL. add metric 'provisional_acked_then_reconciled'.
sre-bot: deploybot: canary of proxy v2.4 started in us-central at 2025-08-12T14:32Z :rocket:
Maria Chen: to land this we need: 1) policy bit in tenant meta, 2) proxy header X-Provisional-Ack: true/false, 3) runtime switch in kv-ownership-check to allow provisional path, 4) e2e test with synthetic residency failover.
Devon Patel: agree. I'll draft a small API sketch for the header:
```
POST /invoke
Headers:
  X-Region-Intent: eu
  X-Provisional-Ack: true
  X-Client-Req-Id: 123
```
Maria Chen: and add a long-term refactor note: unify region-policy decision into a single routing plugin interface so we can swap policy without touching proxy code.
Jordan Lee: + add a simulation job that creates 1000 tenants with mixed residency flags and injects 10% region outages. collect provisional_ack metrics.
Anya Rivera: I'm available to own the observability dashboards.
Maria Chen: thanks. I'll open the RFC follow-up PR with the changes and put the simulation configs in infra/sim. Tagging @Devon to own the proxy header change.
Devon Patel: on it. I'll add the feature flag and a canary plan. :thumbsup:
